Name: Southwestern College - ESL Program (Chula Vista Campus)
Flags: Not from the Council, and different from Sweetwater Adult Ed
Description: Southwestern College's ESL program offers credit-bearing coursework for non-native English speakers, including Certificate of Achievement tracks in ESL Communication and Spanish-to-English Associate Teaching. Coursework prepares students for college-level academic work and professional advancement, with access to a free Language Acquisition Center for study support.

Name: PACT ESL Program - Grossmont-Cuyamaca Community College District
Flags: Not from the Council, different from Grossmont Adult School
Description: ACT offers free beginner ESL classes in the community plus credit-bearing ESL coursework across six proficiency levels at Grossmont and Cuyamaca Colleges, with counseling and financial aid support including the Grossmont-Cuyamaca College Promise program.

Name: Reading Legacies
Flags: Not from the Council, no phone or email on the source page
Description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit that facilitates supportive relationships for children and youth through family and friends reading aloud with them together.

Name: We Strive For Literacy
Flags: Two addresses listed (one in Vista one in Encinitas). The address used was in Vista.
Description: Nonprofit offering reading tutoring for children using EBLI (Evidence-Based Literacy Instruction), covering phonemic awareness, phonics, fluency, vocabulary, comprehension, handwriting, spelling, and writing, delivered via community hubs, family support programs, and school partnerships, both in-person and online.

Name: Encanto Southern Baptist Church Tutoring Program
Flags: Program appears to operate through the church and Encanto Elementary School jointly. No separate program contact was found
Description: Church-run volunteer tutoring program pairing elementary students 6 months to 2.5 years below reading level with volunteers for two one-hour sessions per week; operates in partnership with Encanto Elementary School in Southeast San Diego.

Name: San Diego Adult School
Flags: Different from the San Diego College of Continuing Education
Description: Tuition-free accelerated distance-learning/independent-study adult education program through San Diego Unified School District, offering high school diploma completion, HiSET preparation, and college/career transition support for adults 18+.

Name: Poway Adult School
Description: Poway Unified School District's adult education program offering ESL classes, Adult Secondary Education (high school diploma/GED prep), and career/education counseling for adult students.
